newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Sept industrial output up 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Sept industrial output up 11.1 pct.

text.p: Argentina's industrial output was up 11.1 percent in September against the same month last year, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
Seasonally-adjusted output was down 0.3 percent from August, and nonseasonally-adjusted was down 1.8 percent.

It was the sixth month in a row that industrial production was above the level of the same month in 1995, signalling a further departure from a year-long recession triggered by the December 1994 Mexican peso devaluation.
September's output growth compared with a 7.7 percent rise in August from August last year.
It was also substantially higher than the estimate by the FIEL private consultancy, which last week revised its September growth forecast to 9.2 percent from an earlier estimate of 9.7 percent.
